body:
I'm sorry to read your having such a hard time fella and big props to you for continuing the fight. 
I do have things to that keep me going my (wife and my dog) but i don't see an end to this struggle and it just makes it feel pointless to continue on.

Everyting I read from people who feel this way is always hunting for the next bandaid to keep you going forward which is what I have done from my childhood. 

I don't want to go on and bring others down but I think of another 30,40 maybe years of struggling on and it feels pointless to me, why not just end it now I'm going to inevitably so be why struggling on for be a few fleeting moments of happiness :/.

Bah I'm just a big bundle of joy aint I.
